question.text: When communicating performance of an Investment Approach, a PM must present:

answer.text: TWRR of IA and trailing return of selected benchmark

explanation.text: The Logic: TWRR of IA + trailing benchmark returns are mandatory. The Trap: Simple returns alone or benchmark-free are insufficient. Cross-Exam Context: Same disclosure discipline in X-B. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Same-period TWRR + benchmark comparison prevents cherry-picking.
